# Traceability

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-traceability.mts from handoff/USER_STORIES.md, handoff/STORIES_ADDENDUM.md and docs/traceability.map.json. Do not edit by hand: change the map and regenerate. -->

Every story and every numbered pass criterion, the test that proves it, and where it stands. 122 stories, 328 criteria.

- **Naming:** golden clips are `clip-G1` … `clip-G15`. The typography stories in Epic G are `story-G1` … `story-G7`; their criteria are written `G1.1` … `G7.3`.
- **Statuses:** PASS · FAIL · PARTIAL · N/A (with a reason) · BLOCKED (for example, a clip that has not been sourced) · AGENT-REVIEW-ONLY (an agent has reviewed it with saved evidence; a human has not signed it off, so it is not a pass).
- **Default:** a criterion with no entry in the map is FAIL, "no test yet". If every clip it applies to is unsourced it is BLOCKED instead. Nothing is PASS unless the map names a test, and `scripts/check-traceability.mjs` fails the build if that test id does not exist.
- **A story passes only when every one of its criteria passes** on every clip it applies to.
